capabilities: embed AI chat web UIs in notes via provider codeblocks
save each thread's durable URL back into the note
resume saved conversations from the same note
mark threads done and query thread state with Dataview
disambiguation: Not its own AI assistant or API client; it embeds the providers' web chat UIs and stores thread links in notes, with no API key required.
extras: Has a paid 'Smart Chat Pro' tier (universal codeblock, API chat). Embedded chat UI works on Obsidian desktop only; mobile gets saved thread links but not the full web UI. Claude and Google sign-in require enabling the Web viewer core plugin.
problem: AI chat conversations live in provider apps or browser tabs, detached from the notes they belong to, so threads are hard to resume and track.

relations.evidence: Because Smart Chat stores thread state directly in your notes, Dataview can turn your vault into an async dashboard.
Can I use Open WebUI (Ollama) with Smart Chat? Yes.

requires.name: API key for Pro API chat

summary: Embeds AI chat web UIs like ChatGPT and Claude in note codeblocks and saves each thread's URL with the note so chats stay linked to work.
